rows.purpose: Read the latest entry ID directly for session position and expose a transcript-free context revision keyed by incarnation, conversation, tail, and model context window.
Forward per-chat context revision reads to the runtime facade and expose the optional revision on context usage results.
Bind durable context revisions to the host session generation and discard standalone revision results if that generation changes during the read.
Omit context estimation from passive UI snapshots and return 304 for matching context-only requests using tags that include public token usage counters.
Declare the optional revision on context usage results and a separate lightweight per-chat revision reader for status endpoints.
Wire the web status endpoint to the agent pool revision reader without calling the full context usage reader.
Request passive status and model snapshots without context estimates and forward the scoped revision in status for meter reconciliation.
